fact: On 24 February 2026 the Cellule de Pilotage de la Transformation Numérique convened ACSI and the CURS and PDRCL project teams at the finance ministry, where PDRCL was demonstrated and ACSI was said to be preparing its imminent deployment.
title: Réunion stratégique sur l'avancement des projets CURS et PDRCL au Ministère des Finances
